svg.text: MEA analysis pipeline — end to end
From the MaxWell recording to an AI-written report. Network analysis runs with or without spike sorting; without is the default.
Web UI: status, logs, per-well progress,
Read data.raw.h5 → band-pass filter + common reference →
uncompressed scratch copy of the well (deleted after)
Activity scan — Orchestration-MEA (per chip, CPU, seconds)
Reads the on-chip spike events of the whole-array scan (no sorting, no GPU)
→ activity maps, firing rates and amplitudes, QC verdict, bursts, synchrony
→ how well the Network recording's electrode selection covers the activity
(compared with the same chip's Network recording)
recordings read directly from the NAS (read-only)
